simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֱלִיצָפָן (ʼĔlîytsâphân) means Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 15 8.

definitions.full: H469. Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan אֱלִיצָפָן proper name, masculine ( God has protected , compare Phoenician צפנבעל ) a. chief of the Kohathites Num 3:30 ; 1Chr 15:8 ; 2Chr 29:13 ; = אֶלְצָפָן Exod 6:22 ; Lev 10:4 . b. chief of Zebulun Num 34:25 .
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֶלְצָפָן ; from 410 and 6845 ; God of treasure;
